about: Hand-curated venue research for the Jerusalem International Oud Festival, keyed by the venue codes the confederation-house adapter maps the site's location labels to. Not tied to an edition, because a hall outlives a programme. Every figure is {value, source}, or null when nobody could cite it; coordinates carry the basis they rest on and the page they were read from.

confederation-house.name: בית הקונפדרציה

accessibility.value: חניית נכים, ומערכות עזר לשמע באירועים באולמות הבית.

confederation-house.notes: The festival's home, in Yemin Moshe below the Old City walls. No seat count published.

khan-theatre.name: תיאטרון החאן
khan-theatre.notes: The Jerusalem Khan Theatre, a ten-minute walk from Confederation House. Its main hall seats 232 and its small hall 69 (khan.co.il/halls); the festival does not say which hall, so no capacity is served. OpenStreetMap gives the street but no house number.

jerusalem-theatre.name: תיאטרון ירושלים

accessibility.value: האולמות נגישים לכיסאות גלגלים, עם מערכת הגברה לכבדי שמיעה.

jerusalem-theatre.notes: The Jerusalem Centre for the Performing Arts in Talbiya. The festival plays two of its halls, the Sherover Theatre and the Rebecca Crown Hall.
